paragraphs.en: The Tin Woodman began by informing the meeting that Ozma of Oz had learned of the plight of Evoldo's family. They were enslaved by the Nome King and held captive in an underground palace. Despite her desire to rescue them, Ozma struggled for a long time to find a way across the desert separating their lands.
paragraphs.zh: 铁皮人首先告知大家，奥兹玛女王得知了埃沃尔多家族的困境。他们被诺曼王囚禁并奴役，在一座地底宫殿中被关押着。尽管奥兹玛很想解救他们，但她花了很长时间才找到穿越分隔两地沙漠的方法。

paragraphs.en: Finally, Glinda the Good provided Ozma with a magic carpet that would allow them to cross safely. Ozma then ordered the Tin Woodman to assemble an army of elite soldiers. He described these warriors as the finest in all of Oz and vowed they would fight fiercely if necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，好巫女甘nda为奥兹玛准备了一张魔毯，让她和同伴能安全穿越。随后，奥兹玛命令锡人召集一支精锐部队。她形容这些战士是整个奥兹境内最出色的，并誓言如果必要，他们将拼死战斗。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok questioned why they should fight the Nome King, who had done no wrong. Dorothy countered by asking if imprisoning a queen mother and her children was not wrong. Tiktok explained that Evoldo sold his family to the Nome King for eternal life, which he later destroyed by drowning himself.
paragraphs.zh: 第9章 伊夫王国的王室 提督质疑道，为什么他们要与诺梅国王战斗，而这位国王并没有做错什么。多萝西反问道，将一位女王和她的孩子们囚禁难道不是错误吗？提督解释说，伊尔多把自己家人卖给了诺梅国王以换取永生，后来他自溺身亡，摧毁了这一切。

paragraphs.en: Ozma expressed surprise at this news, stating she believed the Nome King alone was responsible. Regardless, she insisted on liberating the prisoners. Princess Langwidere added that Evoldo's actions were wicked and that he did not gain his promised long life.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛对这个消息感到惊讶，表示她认为诺曼王独揽了这一切。即便如此，她坚持要释放那些囚犯。兰格维德公主补充说，埃沃尔多的行为极其邪恶，并未因此获得他所承诺的长寿。

paragraphs.en: She revealed that Roquat of the Rocks had transformed the family into decorations in his palace.
paragraphs.zh: 她透露，岩石王罗夸特将这家人变成了宫殿里的装饰。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy asked who this Nome King was, highlighting the mystery surrounding their location.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西好奇地问起这位诺姆国王的身份，并强调他们所在之地充满了神秘色彩。

paragraphs.en: Ozma explained, "The Nome King rules the Underground World and commands rocks and their contents. He governs thousands of Nomes—queer-shaped but powerful sprites—who work in furnaces making gold, silver, and precious stones hidden in rock crevices. They also create diamonds and rubies underground."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛解释说：“ Nome王统治着地底世界，并掌控着岩石及其内部的一切。他管辖着成千上万的诺姆人——这些怪异形体却力量强大的精灵，在熔炉中冶炼黄金、白银和珍贵宝石，这些宝石隐藏在岩石缝隙之中。他们还在地下创造出钻石和红宝石。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy nodded wisely. Ozma continued, "Because we often steal his treasures, the Nome King dislikes surface dwellers and never appears among us. To see Roquat of the Rocks, we must visit his kingdom, a dangerous task."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西明智地点了点头。奥兹玛继续说道：“因为我们经常偷他的财宝， Nome 国王对我们地面上的人类很反感，从不现身与我们为伍。要见岩顶兽人罗库特，我们必须访问他的王国，这是一项危险的任务。”

paragraphs.en: "But for the prisoners," Dorothy said, "we should do it."
paragraphs.zh: “不过对那些囚犯来说，”多萝西说道，“我们应该这么做。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow agreed, though he feared the furnaces might ignite him. The Tin Woodman also volunteered, despite the risk of melting.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人同意了，尽管他担心炉火可能会点燃自己。锡人也主动请缨，虽然面临融化的风险。

paragraphs.en: Princess Langwidere yawned lazily and stayed home, wishing them success but eager to change her head for a new one.
paragraphs.zh: 兰格维德公主打着哈欠懒洋洋地待在家里，祝愿他们成功，心里却巴不得换一个脑袋。

paragraphs.en: Ozma asked Tiktok, "Will you join us?" The machine replied, "I am Dor-oth-y's slave; where she goes, I follow."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛对 Ticktock 说道：“你愿意加入我们吗？”机器回答说：“我是多萝西的仆人；她去哪儿，我就跟到哪儿。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy said excitedly, "Of course I'm going with my friends."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西兴奋地说：“当然我会和朋友们一起去。”

paragraphs.en: "Nothing would stop me from having fun," replied Billina nonchalantly, smoothing her feathers.
paragraphs.zh: “没有什么能阻止我享受乐趣。”比琳娜不以为意地回答，梳理着自己的羽毛。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow added, "Heat suits her well. A nice roast will make her better than before."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人补充道：“热气衬得她更佳。一顿美味的烤肉定能让她比以前更好。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma announced, "We'll set off for the Kingdom of the Nomes at dawn tomorrow. Until then, we should rest and prepare ourselves."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛宣布：“我们明天黎明时分出发前往诺姆王国。在此之前，我们应该好好休息，做好准备。”

paragraphs.en: Despite not appearing, Princess Langwidere's servants attended to Dorothy and her friends, making them comfortable in many empty rooms.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管公主朗威德未现身，她的仆人们还是细心照料着多萝西和她的朋友们，让他们在许多空荡荡的房间里感到舒适。

paragraphs.en: The Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger were unharnessed and allowed to roam freely through the palace. They nearly frightened the servants but caused no harm. At one point, Nanda cowered in a corner while the Hungry Tiger stood over her, saying, "You look delicious.
paragraphs.zh: 胆小狮和饿虎被解开缰绳，在宫殿里自由地漫步。虽然吓得仆人们几乎惊叫起来，但并未造成任何伤害。此时，南达瑟缩在一角，而饿虎站在她面前，语气威胁地说：“你看起来很好吃。”

paragraphs.en: Can I eat you?"
paragraphs.zh: “我可以吃了你？”

paragraphs.en: "No!" cried Nanda.
paragraphs.zh: “不！”娜达喊道。

paragraphs.en: The Tiger then said, yawning, "Please give me about thirty pounds of rare steak and five gallons of ice cream."
paragraphs.zh: 老虎打着哈欠说道：“请给我来三十多磅的牛排和五加仑的冰淇淋。”

paragraphs.en: Nanda ran away quickly. Dorothy asked, "Are you really that hungry?" The Tiger replied, "My appetite is so large it fills my whole body.
paragraphs.zh: 南达迅速跑开了。多萝西问道：“你真的那么饿吗？”老虎回答道：“我的食欲大得充盈了全身。”

paragraphs.en: I'll have it removed by a dentist someday."
paragraphs.zh: 总有一天我会让牙医把它拔掉。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy recounted her adventures to her friends. They then set out to find the golden-shod Sawhorse, which Ozma had enchanted.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西向朋友们讲述了她的奇遇。随后，他们决定去寻找奥兹玛施了魔法的金色马蹄铁锯木马。

paragraphs.en: They found the Sawhorse standing by the garden gate. When introduced, he politely bowed and blinked his eyes—knots of wood—and wagged a tree branch for a tail.
paragraphs.zh: 他们在花园门口找到了木马，正站在那里。介绍过后，木马礼貌地鞠了一躬，并眨了眨眼——那是结节累累的木头眼睛。它还摇动着一根树枝充当尾巴。

paragraphs.en: "Remarkable," Dorothy exclaimed. "A living sawhorse!"
paragraphs.zh: “真不赖，”多萝西脱口而出，“竟然还活着的木马！”

paragraphs.en: The Sawhorse agreed, explaining that it was due to magic powder, not his right to live.
paragraphs.zh: 马车木马同意了这个说法，解释说这是由于施了魔法，并非他有生存的权利。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy noted the Scarecrow riding on its back and commented on its usefulness. The Sawhorse confirmed it never tired or needed care.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西注意到木马背上坐着稻草人，并对其实用性发表了一番评论。木马证实说，它从不感到疲倦也不需要照料。

paragraphs.en: When asked about intelligence, the creature admitted knowing just enough to obey commands, finding this sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 当被问及智力时，那 creature 承认自己仅够用一些知识来遵从命令，觉得这已经足够了。

paragraphs.en: That night, Dorothy slept in a cozy bed next to Ozma's room, while Billina perched at the foot of her bed, sleeping soundly under her wing.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，多萝西睡在奥兹玛房间旁边的温暖床上，而比琳娜则栖息在多萝西床脚，翅膀护着她安稳入睡。

paragraphs.en: At dawn, everyone was awake and bustling. In the grand dining hall of the palace, the adventurers quickly ate their breakfast.
paragraphs.zh: 黎明时分，大家已经醒来，忙碌不已。在宫殿的大餐厅里，冒险者们迅速吃完了早餐。

paragraphs.en: Ozma sat at the head of a long table on a raised platform. Dorothy stood to her right, and the Scarecrow to her left. Though the Scarecrow did not eat, Ozma placed him nearby so she could seek his advice during the meal.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛坐在一个高台上的长桌首端。多萝西站在她的右侧，稻草人则站在左侧。虽然稻草人不吃东西，但奥兹玛还是将他安排在附近，以便在用餐时可以征求他的意见。
